final: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) as avg_remain FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) as val FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL), above_b1 AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_remain, b1.val as benchmark1, (oa.avg_remain - b1.val) as excess1 FROM order_avgs oa CROSS JOIN b1 WHERE oa.avg_remain > b1.val), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as val FROM above_b1), above_b2 AS (SELECT ab1.ordersmark, ab1.avg_remain, ab1.benchmark1, b2.val as benchmark2, ab1.excess1, (ab1.avg_remain - b2.val) as excess2 FROM above_b1 ab1 CROSS JOIN b2 WHERE ab1.avg_remain > b2.val) SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as final_average, AVG(excess1) as avg_excess_over_b1, AVG(excess2) as avg_excess_over_b2 FROM above_b2
